reason: 550 zł for the base package, plus 40 zł for every extra child, adds up to 800-900 zł for a whole preschool group, and I can do the same at home or in a hall for half that. On top of that, grandma's cake isn't allowed for the adults and I'd have to buy theirs for 170-190 zł, which would offend her and cost me even more.
objection: Too many add-ons: extra children, the adult cake, the café service, extending the party. The price on the package isn't what I'd actually end up paying, and banning family-baked cakes is a deal-breaker for us.
would_change_my_mind: A flat price for the whole group of about 15 children with no hidden add-ons, around 600 zł, and permission to bring grandma's cake for the adults.
